hash_normalization: UTF-8 LF; the selector span is its contiguous leading comment block, any attributes and the function through its closing brace plus a final newline; source_files hash the whole file
scope: Every Rust test selector in the media crates that is new or whose text changed since base_commit on the claude/media-weight-safety branch. Bound individually; author self-review only, so nothing here is marked independently reviewed or covered.
verifier: Tests/Portable/test_media_register_custody.py recomputes every hash and fails on drift

reviews.protects: one generation at a time, so model and KV-cache memory stay bounded.
reviews.detects: removing the inference gate lets queued async requests overlap.
reviews.needs: no model or GPU; a temp directory for the PNG outputs.

reviews.protects: poll, cancel, init and shutdown stay responsive during a generation.
reviews.detects: holding the state mutex across generation (poll would time out here), a queued request leaving Pending before it owns the gate, a cancelled queued request still running.
reviews.needs: no model or GPU; the in-flight generation is a mock blocked on a channel.

reviews.protects: every synchronous inference entry point (generate, bytes, understand, load) queues behind the gate, so model replacement cannot race a generation.
reviews.detects: an entry point that skips acquire_inference_gate, or one that holds the state mutex while waiting for it (the status calls below would then hang).
reviews.needs: no model loaded in this process; the gate is held by the test as a stand-in for a running generation.

reviews.protects: an incomplete checkpoint is refused at the FFI boundary with an existing status code and a diagnostic naming the missing tensors, and leaves no model loaded.
reviews.detects: a weight-completeness check that is bypassed or whose typed error is flattened into a success; a half-loaded pipeline left behind after failure.
reviews.needs: a temp directory only; the 7B constructor metadata uses scalar-backed views, so nothing large is allocated and no GPU or download is involved.

reviews.protects: a request cancelled while generating never creates or overwrites the caller's destination file, and leaves no staging file.
reviews.detects: encoding straight to the destination before the cancel check.
reviews.needs: a temp directory; the cancel is issued from inside the mock generate.

reviews.protects: a cancel that lands after encoding but before publish still leaves the destination untouched and removes the staging file.
reviews.detects: moving the cancellation check after the publish step (the destination would be replaced and Complete reported).
reviews.needs: a temp directory; the cancel is issued from inside the mock encoder.

reviews.protects: a normal completion publishes the whole file and removes the staging file.
reviews.detects: a publish that leaves the `.partial` name behind or writes a truncated file.
reviews.needs: a temp directory only.

reviews.protects: a failed write reports Failed, leaves no partial file and never touches an existing destination; a failed publish does the same.
reviews.detects: encoding in place, or a staging file leaked on the error path.
reviews.needs: a temp directory; the encoder writes some bytes then fails, and a directory squatting on the destination makes the rename fail.

reviews.protects: the synchronous save path is atomic too: a failure keeps the old file.
reviews.detects: `image.save` writing in place and leaving a truncated destination.
reviews.needs: a temp directory; the destination name has no usable image extension.

reviews.protects: a destination near the 255-character component limit still publishes, on both the asynchronous and synchronous paths.
reviews.detects: a staging name derived from the destination basename (248 + suffix exceeds 255 and the exclusive create fails with an invalid-name error).
reviews.needs: a temp directory on a filesystem with a 255-character component limit.

reviews.protects: staging names are short, independent of the destination, unique per call and live next to the destination.
reviews.detects: a name that embeds the destination basename or repeats between calls.
reviews.needs: nothing on disk.

reviews.protects: shutdown during an in-flight load is final: the finished model is discarded (outside the slot lock) and nothing is loaded afterwards.
reviews.detects: an unconditional install after load (the pre-fix behaviour), or a stale model freed while the slot lock is held.
reviews.needs: no model; the paused load is a closure blocked on a channel.

reviews.protects: the reverse ordering still works: shutdown, then a new load, installs normally, and replacing a model frees the old one outside the lock.
reviews.detects: an epoch check that rejects every load after the first shutdown.
reviews.needs: no model.

reviews.protects: a failed load leaves the slot, and the epoch, alone.
reviews.detects: an error path that clears a previously loaded model.
reviews.needs: no model.

reviews.protects: the exported pcai_media_shutdown invalidates in-flight loads of the real global slot (not just the generic helper).
reviews.detects: shutdown that stops touching MODEL_SLOT, or only clears the handle without bumping the epoch.
reviews.needs: no model.

reviews.protects: a publish on slow or stalled storage blocks nobody else: poll and cancel of other requests answer within 100 ms while one request sits in its rename.
reviews.detects: the rename (or any file IO) running under the global request-table lock.
reviews.needs: no model; the rename is a mock publish step blocked on a channel.

reviews.protects: a failing rename while publishing reports Failed, removes the staging file and leaves the destination alone, again without the global lock.
reviews.detects: an error path that leaves the request Publishing or leaks the partial file.
reviews.needs: a temp directory; the publish step is a mock that fails.
